get_predict_unit: get a pretrained MLIP prediction unit for a specified model name with default or turbo inference settings
get_reference_energies: get atomic or bulk phase element reference energies for a pretrained model from HuggingFace
pretrained_checkpoint_path_from_name: download and return the local checkpoint path for a pretrained model by name from HuggingFace Hub
list_available_models: list all available pretrained model names registered in the pretrained models configuration
HuggingFaceCheckpoint: create a HuggingFace checkpoint dataclass with filename, repo ID, subfolder, revision, and reference energy settings
